title: Curriculum-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Far-Range Rocket Landing
abstract: arXiv:2610.35954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous vertical landing of reusable launch vehicles is a critical yet formidable challenge in aerospace engineering, primarily due to highly nonlinear dynamics, stringent precision require- ments, and inherent environmental uncertainties. While reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional model-based control, existing approaches frequently rely on flat training paradigms and highly simplified initial conditions, drastically limiting their real-world applicability. translated_title: 基于课程驱动的深度强化学习实现火箭自主远距着陆
translated_abstract: 可重复使用运载火箭的自主垂直着陆是航空航天工程中一项关键而又艰巨的挑战，其主要原因在于高度非线性的动力学特性、严苛的精度要求以及固有的环境不确定性。尽管强化学习已成为传统基于模型的控制方法的有前景替代方案，但现有方法通常依赖平坦的训练范式和高度简化的初始条件，极大地限制了其实际应用能力。本文提出了一种全面的课程驱动深度强化学习框架，旨在同时掌握远距导航和精确着陆。通过采用三阶段课程学习，辅以评论家网络预热程序和防止灾难性遗忘的复演机制，并利用基于完整3×3旋转矩阵的高维观测向量，智能体被训练从初始…（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种课程驱动的深度强化学习框架，通过三阶段课程设计、评论家网络预热和防灾难性遗忘的复演机制，并采用完整3×3旋转矩阵的高维观测，实现了火箭从远距初始条件到精确着陆的自主控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a curriculum-driven deep reinforcement learning framework that combines a three-stage curriculum, critic warm-up, and a rehearsal mechanism against catastrophic forgetting, enabling autonomous far-range navigation and precision rocket landing.
